alerts.alertreg.desc: VARCHAR(50) PRIMARY KEY uniquely identifying each alert record

alerts.compreg.desc: UUID REFERENCES Plant(GrowRegistry), referencing which plant component triggered the alert

alerts.deviceref.desc: VARCHAR(50) REFERENCES Panel(PaneMark), linking alert to a specific panel if needed

alerts.incidentref.desc: VARCHAR(50) REFERENCES Performance(PerfRegistry), linking alert to performance data if relevant

alerts.alertmoment.desc: TIMESTAMP logging when the alert was generated (e.g., '2023-07-20 14:05:00')

alerts.alertstat.desc: VARCHAR(50) summarizing the alert’s status or severity (was 'AlertStatus'). Possible enumerations: 'Warning', 'Critical'

alerts.alertcnt.desc: SMALLINT counting how many times this alert occurred (was 'AlertCount') (e.g., 3)

alerts.maintprior.desc: VARCHAR(50) describing the maintenance priority (was 'MaintenancePriority'). Possible enumerations: 'High', 'Medium', 'Low'

alerts.replaceprior.desc: VARCHAR(50) indicating the replacement priority (was 'ReplacementPriority'). Possible enumerations: 'High', 'Medium', 'Low'

alerts.optpotential.desc: VARCHAR(100) reflecting any optimization potential (was 'OptimizationPotential'). Possible enumerations: 'Medium', 'High', 'Low'

electrical.elecregistry.desc: VARCHAR(50) PRIMARY KEY uniquely identifying each electrical record

electrical.engyunitref.desc: VARCHAR(50) REFERENCES Panel(PaneMark), tying this electrical record to a panel

electrical.efflogref.desc: VARCHAR(50) REFERENCES Performance(PerfRegistry), linking to a performance record if relevant

electrical.iscinita.desc: DECIMAL(7,3) short-circuit current (Isc) at initial measurement (was 'IscInitialA') (e.g., 9.200)

electrical.impinita.desc: DECIMAL(7,3) current at maximum power initially (was 'ImpInitialA') (e.g., 8.700)

electrical.vmpinitv.desc: DECIMAL(7,3) voltage at maximum power initially (was 'VmpInitialV') (e.g., 46.500)

environment.envregistry.desc: VARCHAR(50) PRIMARY KEY uniquely identifying each environment record

environment.arearegistry.desc: UUID REFERENCES Plant(GrowRegistry), referencing which plant area is monitored

environment.envmoment.desc: TIMESTAMP noting when these environmental readings were taken (e.g., '2023-07-15 10:30:00')

environment.celltempc.desc: DECIMAL(7,3) measuring the cell temperature in °C (was 'CellTemperatureC') (e.g., 55.120)

environment.cleancycledays.desc: SMALLINT indicating the scheduled cleaning cycle in days (was 'CleaningCycleDays') (e.g., 30)

environment.lastcleandt.desc: DATE for when the last cleaning happened (was 'LastCleaningDate') (e.g., '2023-06-01')

environment.irradiance_conditions.desc: JSONB column. Groups irradiance-related environmental measurements, including global, direct, diffuse, and plane-of-array irradiance, along with spectral mismat

inverter.invertregistry.desc: VARCHAR(50) PRIMARY KEY uniquely identifying each inverter record

inverter.siteref.desc: UUID REFERENCES Plant(GrowRegistry), indicating which plant’s inverter we are tracking

inverter.invertmoment.desc: TIMESTAMP noting when this inverter reading was taken (e.g., '2023-07-15 10:40:00')

inverter.gridvolt.desc: NUMERIC(7,3) the AC grid voltage in volts (was 'GridVoltageV') (e.g., 400.000)

inverter.gridfreqhz.desc: DECIMAL(7,3) the AC grid frequency in Hz (was 'GridFrequencyHz') (e.g., 50.050)

inverter.power_metrics.desc: JSONB column. Stores key performance metrics related to the inverter's power output and quality, including efficiency, power factor, and harmonic distortion

maintenance.maintregistry.desc: VARCHAR(50) PRIMARY KEY uniquely identifying each maintenance record

maintenance.powerref.desc: UUID REFERENCES Plant(GrowRegistry), referencing which plant is maintained

maintenance.compref.desc: VARCHAR(50) REFERENCES Panel(PaneMark), referencing the panel if maintenance is panel-specific

maintenance.obsref.desc: VARCHAR(50) REFERENCES Performance(PerfRegistry), linking to performance data if relevant

maintenance.inspectmeth.desc: VARCHAR(100) describing the inspection method (was 'InspectionMethod'). Possible enumerations: 'Visual', 'IR Thermal', 'IV Curve', 'EL Imaging'

maintenance.inspectres.desc: VARCHAR(150) noting the inspection result (was 'InspectionResult'). Possible enumerations: 'Minor Issues', 'Major Issues', 'Pass'

maintenance.inspectdate.desc: DATE specifying when inspection took place (was 'InspectionDate') (e.g., '2023-07-01')

maintenance.maintsched.desc: VARCHAR(100) summarizing the maintenance schedule (was 'MaintenanceSchedule'). Possible enumerations: 'Delayed', 'Overdue', 'On Schedule'

maintenance.wtystatus.desc: VARCHAR(50) describing the warranty status (was 'WarrantyStatus'). Possible enumerations: 'Claimed', 'Active', 'Expired'

maintenance.wtyclaimcnt.desc: SMALLINT counting how many warranty claims have been filed (was 'WarrantyClaimCount'). Possible enumerations: 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5

maintenance.maintcostusd.desc: DECIMAL(9,2) cost of maintenance in USD (was 'MaintenanceCostUSD') (e.g., 250.00)

maintenance.cleancostusd.desc: NUMERIC(8,3) cost of cleaning in USD (was 'CleaningCostUSD') (e.g., 50.125)

maintenance.replacecostusd.desc: DECIMAL(9,3) cost to replace components in USD (was 'ReplacementCostUSD') (e.g., 1200.500)

maintenance.revlossusd.desc: NUMERIC(7,2) revenue loss in USD due to downtime (was 'RevenueLossUSD') (e.g., 100.25)

panel.panemark.desc: VARCHAR(50) PRIMARY KEY uniquely identifying each panel record

panel.hubregistry.desc: UUID REFERENCES Plant(GrowRegistry), linking this panel to a specific plant

panel.panemfr.desc: VARCHAR(100) describing the manufacturer’s name (was 'PanelManufacturer'). Possible enumerations: 'Longi', 'Canadian Solar', 'JA Solar', 'JinkoSolar', 'Trina'

panel.paneline.desc: VARCHAR(100) capturing the panel’s model line or series (was 'PanelModel') (e.g., 'ModelX', 'CS6K-P')

panel.panetype.desc: VARCHAR(50) labeling the panel type (was 'PanelType'). Possible enumerations: 'Mono-PERC', 'HJT', 'Poly-PERC', 'Bifacial', 'TOPCon'

panel.powratew.desc: SMALLINT specifying the rated power output of the panel in watts (was 'PanelRatedPowerW'). Possible enumerations: 650, 450, 600, 550, 500

panel.paneeffpct.desc: DECIMAL(7,3) storing the panel’s nominal efficiency percentage (was 'PanelEfficiencyPercent') (e.g., 21.345)

panel.nomtempc.desc: NUMERIC(7,3) indicating the panel’s nominal operating temperature in °C (was 'NominalOperatingTempC') (e.g., 45.000)

panel.tempcoef.desc: DECIMAL(4,3) capturing the temperature coefficient for panel performance (was 'TemperatureCoefficient') (e.g., -0.350)

performance.perfregistry.desc: VARCHAR(50) PRIMARY KEY uniquely identifying each performance record

performance.solmodref.desc: VARCHAR(50) REFERENCES Panel(PaneMark), linking performance data to a panel

performance.perfmoment.desc: TIMESTAMP noting when these performance metrics were recorded (e.g., '2023-07-15 10:30:00')

performance.measpoww.desc: NUMERIC(9,3) logging the measured power in watts (was 'MeasuredPowerW') (e.g., 595.000)

performance.powlossw.desc: DECIMAL(8,3) detailing power loss in watts (was 'PowerLossW') (e.g., 10.500)

performance.efficiency_profile.desc: JSONB column. Captures efficiency and degradation metrics for a solar panel, including current efficiency, losses, and degradation rates

plant.growregistry.desc: UUID PRIMARY KEY uniquely identifying each plant record (was 'RecordID') (e.g., '3fa85f64-5717-4562-b3fc-2c963f66afa6')

plant.growalias.desc: VARCHAR(100) naming or aliasing the plant (was 'PlantName') (e.g., 'DesertSolarOne', 'ValleyGridAlpha')

plant.gencapmw.desc: NUMERIC(7,3) indicating the generation capacity in megawatts (was 'PlantCapacityMW') (e.g., 12.500)

plant.initdate.desc: DATE representing the plant’s installation or commissioning date (was 'InstallationDate') (e.g., '2022-05-10')
